prompt: I'm a dentist. What does the Brick & Mortar Funnels book recommend to get 100 new patients in 100 days, and how would I get reviews and referrals?
assertions: Describes Anissa Holmes' four-phase plan with day ranges (1-45 warm audience; 46-50 funnels; 51-80 nurture; 81-100 traffic)
Includes the local business gift card giveaway and smile makeover competition
Mentions building Facebook retargeting audiences and training the team on phone conversion
Mentions high-value treatment funnels (implants, Invisalign) and/or the 30-Day Floss Challenge
Covers reviews/referrals via Tyler Shaule's NPS rate-review-referral funnel (~300 five-star reviews) or similar book method
Includes compliance cautions (e.g., TCPA/SMS consent, HIPAA/testimonials, review gating)
